mapper.select: SELECT data_id, data_name, data_type, book_id, book_name, org_id, org_name, period, amount, currency, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM finance_data WHERE data_id = #{dataId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_data ( data_id, data_name, data_type, book_id, book_name, org_id, org_name, period, amount, currency, status, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{data.dataId}, #{data.dataName}, #{data.dataType}, #{data.bookId}, #{data.bookName}, #{data.orgId}, #{data.orgName}, #{data.period}, #{data.amount}, #{data.currency}, #{data.status}, #{data.createBy}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE finance_data SET data_name = #{data.dataName}, data_type = #{data.dataType}, book_id = #{data.bookId}, book_name = #{data.bookName}, org_id = #{data.orgId}, org_name = #{data.orgName}, period = #{data.period}, amount = #{data.amount}, currency = #{data.currency}, status = #{data.status}, update_by = #{data.updateBy}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE data_id = #{data.dataId}
mapper.select: SELECT data_type, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(amount) as total_amount, AVG(amount) as avg_amount FROM finance_data WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY data_type
